hook: Malkajgiri station toilets shut for *two years*
hook_b: Malkajgiri station toilets shut for *two years*
tldr: Passenger washrooms at the redeveloped Malkajgiri railway station remain closed because the station has not been commissioned yet.

beats.what: The station was redeveloped under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, but its toilets, including those for women, are not open to the public.
beats.why: SCR has not yet inaugurated the redeveloped station, so its new facilities stay locked.
beats.care: Women passengers often have to ask the station master or staff to use their washrooms, commuters say.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Train Travellers Association has asked SCR to open the pending washrooms, especially ladies' toilets, without delay.

cards.q: What should SCR do first at Malkajgiri?

qs: Why has the redeveloped station not been commissioned?
How many daily passengers use Malkajgiri station?

facts.t: Commuters say they have faced the problem for *nearly two years*.

steps.e: Station rebuilt under Amrit Bharat scheme

viz.verdict: Daily commuters, especially women, without toilets

learn.t: ABSS = Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, the Railways' station redevelopment programme.

watch: When SCR schedules the station's inauguration, which it is reportedly planning.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Malkajgiri rail passengers struggle without toilets as station awaits inauguration

fact: Redeveloped Malkajgiri station's toilets stay shut for nearly *two years*
twist: Commuters are asking for just *one or two* mobile toilets until the station opens.
